summary: Frontend-only retest of the USP India CMS. (1) Header and hero alignment on 8 pages at 7 widths: the hero box edges now line up with the home hero's left edge and the nav band's right edge (within 1px) on every page and width, with no horizontal overflow. The header is NOT yet identical everywhere: Workshops has a narrower header box at about 701-1000px, brand and menu text colours differ per page at all widths, and the mobile/tablet brand size differs per page. (2) Field Notes title is 28px and the Explore link sits about 20-22px below the cards on desktop. (3) Live editor: all the FIXED items pass. These are the device preview portal (toggles and Back to editing clickable), header style overrides (live and on the public site), site-text font size on brand_label, full_name and the footer copyright, the footer email being clickable, the contact.email default, and no React warning on undo/redo. Grip placement no longer overlaps the S handle or toolbar, drag-to-move works and the text hint is correct. Regression checks for text edit, save, undo/redo, crop/zoom, media replace and public persistence all pass. New issues found: Ctrl+Z is ignored while a text element is focused (for example right after dragging it), the header background does not cover the white brand area, the site-text Location does not follow the chosen Field, and a few small UI nits. All test content was restored from the backup, and the DB diff is clean.

ui_bugs.issue: The header box is 95.6% wide with auto margins (at 820px it spans 18-802 instead of 0-820). Brand and menu shift inwards, so the header no longer matches the other pages. At 700px and below, and at 1024px and above, it is fine.
ui_bugs.selector: #site-header (workshops-reference.css line 3: .site:has(#workshops-reference) .header {width:95.6%; margin:24px auto 4px} - only margin-top is reset at line 89, width is not)

ui_bugs.issue: The header is not identical across pages. Brand-name colour: home rgb(87,87,87); about/theatre/field-notes/connect rgb(31,31,31); rakhigarhi rgb(39,46,51); craft rgb(69,69,69); workshops rgb(38,62,77) (visibly blue). The nav colour is rgb(87,87,87) on home vs rgb(38,38,38) elsewhere. The brand-sub colour also differs.

ui_bugs.component: Header brand size at 960px and below (tablet/mobile)
ui_bugs.issue: Brand size: home 32px; about/theatre/field-notes/connect 25.6px (index.css:1113 sets 1.6rem at max-width 960px); rakhigarhi/craft/workshops 30px (page reference css). The brand-sub top position and the hamburger x position differ by 1-2px. Header height is the same (78px).

Ctrl/Cmd+Z does nothing while the selected text element has focus (contenteditable). Repro: select the 'WHO WE ARE' eyebrow, drag the grip, press Ctrl+Z. Nothing reverts. The Undo button works. The cause is the 'typing' guard in the key handler (LiveEditor.jsx ~line 444/447). It skips editor undo whenever focus is inside [contenteditable=true], even when the last change was a move, resize or style change and native text undo has nothing to undo.

Setting 'Header background' only colours the outer #site-header band. The inner .header-inner (brand area) stays white (#fff), so the user sees a white box in a coloured band. Navigation background works.

When a field is picked from the Field dropdown, Location keeps its previous value instead of the field's real location (full_name defaults to Footer, display.copyright to Header). Changing the size then has no visible effect until the user fixes Location by hand. Clicking the element on the page sets it correctly.
Esc does not close the mobile/tablet preview. Only 'Back to editing' does.
On large elements that reach under the floating panel (for example the theatre hero image), the red selection outline and handles are drawn on top of the editor panel's content.

After filling inputs low in Style & spacing (min height, padding), the panel (overflow:hidden, inner scroll) is scrolled by focus. The tabs scroll out of view and the Save footer appears in the middle with fields below it. It returns to normal after reopening.

issues: The Explore Field Notes gap is 20-22px at 1024px and above but 42px at 820/390px. Check whether that is intended.

action_items: HIGH: workshops-reference.css: reset width/margin of .site:has(#workshops-reference) .header for 701-1000px (or remove the 95.6% rule) so the header is full width like the other pages.

MEDIUM: make header brand, brand-sub and nav colours identical on every page. Page reference stylesheets (rakhigarhi/craft/workshops/about etc.) override them; add one high-specificity global header rule.
MEDIUM: unify the mobile/tablet brand-name size (home 32px vs 25.6px vs 30px).
MEDIUM: allow editor undo/redo with Ctrl+Z when focus is in the selected contenteditable but there is no pending text draft (or always route to editor undo after committing inlineDraft).
MEDIUM: HeaderStyleTag backgroundColor should also apply to .header-inner (or make header-inner transparent when an override is set).

LOW: auto-set Location from the field's actual DOM location when choosing from the Field dropdown; let Esc close the device preview; keep the selection box below the panel; fix the header panel scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveEditor.jsx is 697 lines, at the 700-line limit. Extract the keyboard and drag hooks.

The header look is still decided by many page-specific reference stylesheets with !important (home/rakhigarhi/craft/workshops/about). Every 'one header' fix becomes a specificity race. Consolidate header CSS into one file scoped to #site-header and stop page CSS from touching the header.
SiteChromeEditor chooseField uses window.confirm. That works, but it is untestable and blocks the UI. Consider an in-panel confirm.

success_rate.frontend: about 85%. Hero alignment 100% at all pages and widths. Header identical: fails on workshops 701-1000px, plus colour and mobile size drift. Every FIXED live-editor item passes. Regressions pass. New medium issues: Ctrl+Z in focused text, header bg inner area.

seed_data_creation: None kept. Test edits (tagline text, eyebrow move, header styles, site-text sizes for brand_label/full_name/copyright, theatre image crop+replace) were all restored with backup_restore_content.py. The diff is clean and the start backup equals the current state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'python /app/tests/backup_restore_content.py backup' before mutating, then 'restore' and 'diff' after. The /tmp backup of the original content equals /tmp/content_backup_iter3_start.json, and the iter2 copy is /app/tests/.content_backup_iter2.json. Device toggle testids are live-device-mobile/tablet/desktop; the overlay uses live-preview-*. Site-text field changes with unsaved edits trigger window.confirm, which Playwright auto-dismisses. Add page.on('dialog', accept) or save between fields. Save clears undo history by design. Header panel tab 'Style & spacing' is a button inside [data-testid=live-header-panel]. Expected anonymous 401s on /api/auth/*.
rca of the issue: Workshops header: workshops-reference.css:3 sets .header {width:95.6%; margin:24px auto 4px}. The @media block at line 89 only resets margin-top. The global full-width header rule only wins at 1001px and above (and the ≤700px block resets it), so the 701-1000px range keeps 95.6%. Colour and size drift: home-reference.css, rakhigarhi/craft/workshops-reference.css and index.css:1111/1113 each set their own brand-name colour and font-size per page. Ctrl+Z: the key handler's 'typing' check includes [contenteditable=true], and the selected text element stays contenteditable/focused after a grip drag.
